pages.text: Overall route: harvest tea -> make green, white, yellow, red, dark, and oolong tea -> brew at the tea table -> drink infusions.$(br2)Collecting all six tea categories completes the “Six Tea Categories” advancement and lights up this Patchouli task.

pages.title: Suggested Order
pages.text: Start with green tea to learn fixation, then white and red tea for withering and rolling, then yellow, dark, and oolong tea for yellowing, piling, and roasting.
